type: information-gap audit (no backfill, no model, no picks)

marketGapQuant2023_vs_DraftKings.note: 2023 is the ONLY season CFBD stored DraftKings alongside proxies. Mean |proxy - DK| on spread.
marketGapQuant2023_vs_DraftKings.interpretation: Best real-book proxy is ~0.7-1.0 pt off DraftKings; consensus ~1.2 pt. Around key numbers 3 and 7 this routinely flips ATS covers. The proxy error EXCEEDS any edge Phase 5 could find, so a consensus/proxy-trained edge cannot be trusted to transfer to DraftKings.

matrix.candidate: Situational / schedule features (rest diff, consecutive road, travel distance, timezone change, altitude, neutral, conference, prev-game margin, prev-game OT, bye week, short week, SOS-of-prior)
matrix.timestamps: kickoff timestamp present for 6719/6719 games; venue coords for 852 venues
matrix.caveat: Phase 4 already found rest/games-played ~0 signal; several of these were effectively tested and are near-dead. Free but unlikely to move the needle.

matrix.candidate: Real-sportsbook historical lines (William Hill / Bovada / Caesars) as the MARKET feature, restricted to the real-book era
matrix.timestamps: NONE (CFBD lines carry no timestamp) - cannot be labelled a closing line
matrix.leakageRisk: low-moderate: no timestamp means we cannot prove pre-kickoff; treat as 'a line', not 'the close'
matrix.caveat: Still 0.7-1.0 pt off DraftKings and only covers ~2019-2023. Improves realism vs consensus but is not a NEW predictive signal.

matrix.candidate: Live DraftKings market (open + current + lastUpdatedAt) via SGO
matrix.historicalSource: NONE - SGO returned 0 events for a 2019 window; live/forward only
matrix.liveSource: SGO /v2/events (already wired), fields: bookOdds, openBookOdds, byBookmaker.draftkings.lastUpdatedAt
matrix.timestamps: YES (per-book lastUpdatedAt) - true pre-kickoff snapshots possible going forward
matrix.coverage: live NCAAF only; amateur tier cap 2500 entities/month, 10 req/min
matrix.cost: entity-capped (2500/month) - fine for weekly live pulls, impossible for bulk history
matrix.informationValue: HIGH (for the product / forward CLV), ZERO for historical training
matrix.caveat: This is the asymmetry at the heart of the problem: DraftKings data exists ONLY going forward, never for 2015-2023.

matrix.candidate: Weather (temp, wind speed/gust, precip, humidity, severe) at venue+kickoff hour
matrix.historicalSource: Open-Meteo ARCHIVE (ERA5 actual obs, back to 1940) OR Historical-Forecast API (archived forecasts)
matrix.earliestSeason: archive: 2015 fine (deep); historical-forecast: returned 2019 & 2023 data but pre-2021 depth NEEDS VERIFICATION (may fall back to reanalysis)
matrix.timestamps: archive = actual obs at kickoff hour (NOT a pre-kickoff forecast); historical-forecast = time-safe archived forecast
matrix.coverage: outdoor venues only; dome games weather-irrelevant (dome flag known)
matrix.leakageRisk: ARCHIVE = mild forward bias (train on actuals, serve on forecast); HISTORICAL-FORECAST = time-safe
matrix.informationValue: LOW-MEDIUM (mostly affects totals/unders, weak on spread)
matrix.caveat: Train/serve parity imperfect if archive used. Prefer historical-forecast where depth is genuine; otherwise accept the actuals-vs-forecast mismatch as a known YELLOW.

matrix.candidate: QB experience / returning starters / OL continuity / starter-weighted talent
matrix.historicalSource: CFBD /roster + /player/usage + /player/returning + /stats/player/season + /recruiting (all 200 OK); starter identity needs /games/players backfill
matrix.liveSource: same endpoints preseason; NO in-season injury-driven update source
matrix.earliestSeason: roster/usage/returning 2014-2015+; transfer portal EMPTY for 2019 (starts ~2021 - verify)
matrix.coverage: good preseason; cannot capture mid-season starter changes
matrix.leakageRisk: preseason-static = safe; anything implying 'who actually played' risks leakage and needs care
matrix.caveat: Captures preseason roster value only. The high-value part (in-season QB out / late scratch) is unobtainable because there is no injury source.

matrix.candidate: Injuries / availability / questionable-doubtful-out / suspensions / opt-outs / late scratches / depth-chart changes
matrix.historicalSource: NONE - CFBD /injuries returns 404; no timestamped injury feed available in this project
matrix.timestamps: n/a - any retrospective injury list would be untimestamped and hindsight-contaminated
matrix.cost: would require a paid injury API with historical timestamps (not present)
matrix.leakageRisk: SEVERE - untimestamped retrospective injuries leak the outcome; explicitly rejected
matrix.caveat: This is the most valuable missing feature and it cannot be reconstructed leakage-safe. Reject.

matrix.candidate: Timestamped historical DraftKings CLOSING line / full line-movement history
matrix.historicalSource: NONE - CFBD DraftKings = 2023 only and untimestamped; SGO = no history on this tier
matrix.cost: would require a premium historical odds vendor (e.g. paid line-history feed) - not present
matrix.informationValue: HIGHEST - would resolve the train/serve gap
matrix.caveat: The single most important addition and it is NOT available. Do not fabricate or approximate it as 'closing'.

reject: CFBD 'spread' field labelled as a closing line (no timestamp exists)
Any consensus/proxy-trained edge asserted as a DraftKings edge (proxy error 0.7-1.2 pt > any edge found)
SGO as a historical backfill source (returns nothing for past seasons; 2500 entity/month cap)
numberfire / teamrankings treated as 'market' (they are model predictions, not sportsbooks)
